system.description:
11th Level Clan Feature

You’ve blown up enough things to know how to not blow up everything. While you are not in combat, you can spend 10 minutes placing and tuning a Prime to Breach a surface or structure within your reach.

Breach. You blow a 5-foot-wide hole through up to 5 feet of material, even if chakra reinforced.

| #### Cataclysm Knuckle / Battle Amp / While in this state, you gain the following benefits; / Blast Zone. You are immune to the harmful effects of your Primes, Bakuton Hijutsu and Clan features. / Black Powder Pressure. When you deal [Unarmed Damage] to a creature and Prime them, they are marked twice instead of once. / Detonation Momentum. You gain a bonus to your attack critical threat range when attacking a Primed creature. This bonus is equal to the number of Primes they have active on them. |

Additionally, you can ensure negotiations, while hostile, go your way. As part of making an Intimidation or Persuasion check against a non-combat ready creature, you can pretend to set a visible charge, Priming yourself or another creature, object or structure within 10-feet of you. On a successful check, the target becomes extremely compliant for the next minute, answering the next question as truthfully as possible, delaying sounding alarms and even escorting you somewhere to avoid blowing up with you. A creature will attempt to defend themselves if they take damage or realize the Prime was fake. To realize a Prime is fake a creature makes a perception check vs your highest jutsu save DC.
